'''2011 German National Championship Ziemowit Skwara DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ziemowit Skwara]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Ziemowit Skwara "Kryptofis"
* '''Deck name:''' Super Rops
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
